shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,420p' ../round-brief.md; git status --short --branch; git log -5 --oneline; git diff origin/main...HEAD -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts package.json package-lock.json specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md; sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts; sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts; sed -n '1,240p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts; sed -n '1,220p' src/types/ai.ts; cat tsconfig.json; cat package.json | sed -n '1,130p'; rg \"new Ajv|ValidateFunction|inputSchema\" src/orchestration -g '*.ts'; rg \"specs/.*#|spec:\" src -g '*.test.ts' | head -40; rg --files scripts/spec-links .lore 2>/dev/null"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "node -p \"require('./node_modules/ajv/package.json').version\"; rg \"interface Options|type Options\" node_modules/ajv/dist node_modules/ajv/lib -g '*.d.ts' | head; rg \"AjvOptions|validateFormats\" node_modules/ajv/dist/core.d.ts node_modules/ajv/lib/core.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv.d.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg \"constructor\\(options\\?: Options\\)\" node_modules -g '*.d.ts' | head -20; rg '\"@types/ajv\"|node_modules/@types/ajv' package-lock.json node_modules/.package-lock.json; timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md && nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,60p' && rg -n \"validates each function-valued\" specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git diff --check && git status --short && git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "feat(tools): validate resolved input schemas" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
